choices.content: Two triangles with equal areas are congruent
Two triangles with equal perimeters are congruent
Two figures that can be made to coincide exactly are congruent
Two figures with the same shape are congruent

question.prompt: Which of the following statements is correct?

solutions.explanation: Congruent figures are defined as figures that can be made to coincide exactly. Equal areas, equal perimeters, or the same shape do not guarantee that the figures can coincide exactly.
solutions.title: Definition of congruence
